description: Look up movies, TV shows and anime, and read your Simkl watch history and lists.

simkl_new_anime_on_watchlist_trigger.description: Runs for each new anime on watchlist in Simkl. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

simkl_new_movie_on_watchlist_trigger.description: Runs for each new movie on watchlist in Simkl. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields movie.title, movie.ids.simkl, status, last_watched_at

simkl_new_show_on_watchlist_trigger.description: Runs for each new show on watchlist in Simkl. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
